message: padding is only partly supported in Outlook Windows
hint: Partial. Only supported on table cells.

message: data-email-each on an item of a row or grid
hint: data-email-each / -if / -unless work on a block in a stack or on text-level elements; on a row item or grid cell the column widths would depend on data. Wrap the row in the construct, or put it inside the cell.
